title: Force used on peaceful protesters
officerCan: Use force that is necessary and proportionate to a lawful purpose.
officerCannot: Use force disproportionate to the situation.
Use force against people who are peaceful and complying.

quotableLine.en: We are peaceful and we are complying.
quotableLine.hi: हम शांतिपूर्ण हैं और हम पालन कर रहे हैं।
quotableLine.bn: আমরা শান্তিপূর্ণ এবং আমরা নির্দেশ মানছি।
quotableLine.mr: आम्ही शांततेत आहोत आणि आदेश पाळत आहोत.

doNotSay: Any gesture that can be read as retaliation.
documentNow: Faces, unit or vehicle numbers, the time, and injuries — before anyone is moved.

options.label: Move out of the immediate area first.
options.rationale: Nothing you document matters more than not being injured.

options.label: Continue recording from a distance.
options.rationale: Distance is what separates documenting from obstruction.

options.label: Record injuries and get medical attention documented.
options.rationale: Medical records made contemporaneously carry far more weight later.

verification.notes: Placeholder from PRD table. Not checked against bare act. Needs advocate sign-off for legal accuracy AND for escalation risk (PRD R3).
